answer: Each identity binds one registered master sommelier diploma, registry-checked: one diploma backs one identity, duplicates rejected, revocation voids it. Earning it takes a three-year course, two harvest seasons in a vineyard orchard, and an exam: fourteen theory sections, a sonnet of blind-tasting pours, a fourteen-course service test. Each fake costs 1,500 units, 1,095 days; 100 fakes cost 150,000 units and 300 person-years. Cheapest cheat is renting a diploma: the lender surrenders their own backing and faces charges, while a forgery fails the serial check under the lantern-lit register.
